'''North Acrola''' is a sub-continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[Middle Acrola]] and [[South Acrola]] to the south. [[Central Ayuma]] to the west, [[North Acrola]] to the north, and the [[Hinsakian Ocean|Great Hinsakian Ocean]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|9,977,889|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 3rd largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 715,830,862 as of 1765, making it also the 2nd largest sub-continent by population.
